stance_rationale: Optimizer approval is not supportable because required production weight artifacts are absent, the emitted overlay schedule is 94.74% placeholder, and the W3 beta path is generated from a random illustrative distribution rather than actual Forge p_bad_t. The package is acceptable only as a design note, not as an optimizer package satisfying RF-O checklist gates.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: M05 selected by qualitative design criteria before actual p_bad_t, Path A/B/C backtest, net_IR, DM, or realized cost metrics exist

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: Role formula turnover x 15bps x 2 gives 156.5bps for W3_TO_ann=5.217, while package cites 10~25bps incremental and Path analysis cites ~54bps. Unit is inconsistent and actual Forge turnover is pending.

sequential_admission_audit.integration_weight_breakdown: Path A/B/C formulas are specified, but blended SR/MDD/IR/net_IR and realized integration costs are all pending Forge Stage 5.

critical_concerns.description: weights.csv is absent and target_weights/active_weights are null, so n_names, max_w, sigma_w, and long-only cannot be revalidated; overlay_schedule.csv is not the required as_of_date x ticker x weight x method_selected schedule.

build_overlay_schedule_template.R constructs W3 p_bad_t via rnorm/sample, but the package claims self_synthesis_used=false and treats the W3 schedule as an OOS illustrative reference; that invalidates threshold, turnover, and cost pass claims.

method_shopping_log reports 12 candidates despite the role prompt's <=10 cap, and M05 is selected without realized net_IR/cost-adjusted metrics because actual p_bad_t and Path A/B/C backtests do not exist.
Turnover and cost accounting are internally inconsistent: overlay_summary says W3_TO_ann=5.217, threshold_sensitivity says 1.5~2.5/yr, and the cost estimates do not reconcile to turnover x 15bps x 2.

M4 redundancy remains unresolved: risk flags 87.69% M4 agreement and DM mandatory, while path_a_vs_b says Path A needs no DM because signals differ; no DM p-value, per-window result, or net_IR uplift is available.

Crisis fallback is under-specified: compound beta can drive near-cash exposure, but there is no explicit cash sleeve, boundary shrink, realized MDD/CVaR, or portfolio stress metric for the CRISIS path.
alpha_scores.parquet and the qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260518_001 directory are missing, so the Iter 4 time-series alpha dimension and Forge Stage 4 handoff cannot be verified.

supporting_arguments: stage_artifacts/WT_D20260518_001/covariance.parquet is PSD and independently computes cond=76.47 <= 100, so the post-shrink covariance artifact passes the requested PSD/condition check.
overlay_schedule.csv contains 437 monthly sig_dates, but 414 are TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER and only 23 W3 rows contain illustrative beta values.
Hill alpha k20=4.099, so the RF-O12 heavy-tail override is not the binding objection here.
TDC_lower=0.0769 and abs correlation with PG2 alpha=0.1363 are supportive only after actual p_bad_t, DM, and cost-adjusted Path A/B/C metrics exist.
unresolved_disputes: Whether scalar overlay status is allowed to exempt the optimizer from weights.csv and stock-level hard-constraint audit; current role prompt does not grant that exemption.
Whether simulated W3 beta values may be used in any pass/fail audit; they should be excluded or clearly labeled synthetic.
Whether Path A DM testing is mandatory; optimizer artifacts contradict each other.
Whether turnover is measured as transition count, absolute beta delta, or stock-level traded notional.
Whether underlying STR_1715 holdings actually retain max_names=20, max_w<=0.20, sigma_w=1, and liquidity constraints in this task handoff.
weakest_assumption: A placeholder and partially simulated overlay_schedule can substitute for a real walk-forward weights schedule and justify optimizer approval before actual p_bad_t, alpha_scores, DM tests, net_IR, and realized costs exist.
rebuttal_required: Provide weights.csv or a formally approved overlay-specific schema with actual beta_bear per date, underlying holdings hash, and verifiable stock-level constraints.
Regenerate overlay_schedule.csv from real Forge Stage 4 p_bad_t, not rnorm/sample simulation.
Reduce method_shopping candidates to <=10 or document a formal cap exemption, then report actual net_IR/cost-adjusted comparisons.
Reconcile turnover and cost units under turnover x 15bps x 2 and issue infeasibility_report if full-sample turnover exceeds 6.0/yr.
Produce DM full/per-window/per-regime results and Path A/B/C SR, MDD, IR, DSR, and cost metrics.
rationalization_red_flags: real Forge Stage 5 actual emission expected lower
safe rollback / no-op fallback used before realized backtest evidence
Conservative selection used as a substitute for measured net_IR

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Optimizer self-PASS is not an independent verification source. Forge and Architect are pending, and the available schedule is placeholder/simulated rather than a production walk-forward artifact.
